violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. -Cover mozzarella sticks in freezer.
Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Sprayer for sanitizing food contact surfaces was too strong. Needs to be at 100 ppm cl. Waws at +200 ppm cl
Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Defrost upright freezer.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. -Box of cups sitting on floor.
Handling and storage of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Secondary container of poisonous or toxic material was not clearly identified to indicated contents. -2 spray bottles not labeled.
Number, location, accessibility, soap and paper towels provided (3 pts deducted)
Handwashing, good hygienic practices (5 pts deducted)
Design, installation, clean, and maintained (1 pt deducted)
